# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Explore More**

These pages are for you, if you want to learn more on your own. Nothing here is homework.

Each lesson in class covers one big idea and one main activity. There is always more to the story: more history, more demos, and harder questions. You find them here, one page for each unit. At the bottom of a lesson, look for the 🔭 **Explore More** link.

Read a section. Try the demo. Then tell Mr. Ross what you found.
